summary.text: Sophia Tjotjos is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, an open seat with no incumbent.
An attorney, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her campaign focuses on lower property taxes, fiscal responsibility and priorities for Westside communities.

paragraphs.text: Sophia Tjotjos graduated from Lakewood High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University in 1981 and a law degree from Case Western Reserve School of Law in 1984.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mother of four, grandmother of two, longtime attorney, small business owner and lifelong Westsider.
Tjotjos advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
She said she supports property valuation reform, including considering caps, freezes or circuit breakers, and zero-based budgeting for state agencies.
